newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill cuts cement cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill cuts cement cos.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said analyst Jon Goldfarb downgraded several cement companies.
-- cut Centex Construction Products Inc to long-term accumulate from buy, and kept the near-term accumulate rating.
-- reduced Giant Cement Holding Inc to accumulate from buy both near term and long term.
-- downgraded Lafarge Corp to accumulate from buy both near term and long term.
-- cut Lone Star Industries Inc to accumulate from buy both near term and long term.
-- Southdown Inc was reduced to accumulate from buy both near term and long term.
-- and Medusa Corp was lowered to accumulate from buy both near term and long term.
-- Centex was unchanged at 17-1/2, Giant was unchanged at 16-3/8, Lafarge was off 1/4 to 23-3/4, Lone Star dropped one 42-3/4, Southdown was off 5/8 to 35-3/4, and Medusa fell 7/8 to 39-1/8.
